user.title: Samsung Find - Login
user.description:
## Setup Steps

1. Open [{login_url}]({login_url}) and sign in with your Samsung account
2. Once the map loads, press **F12** to open DevTools
3. Go to the **Network** tab and click on any request to `api.samsungfind.com`
4. In **Request Headers**, copy the values of:
   - **x-sec-sa-authtoken** → paste into *Auth Token*
   - **x-sec-sa-userid** → paste into *User ID*
   - **x-sec-sa-countrycode** → paste into *Country Code*

⚠️ **Note:** The auth token expires after **1 hour**. When it expires, Home Assistant will show a re-authentication notification. You will need to repeat the steps above to obtain a fresh token.

error.invalid_auth: Authentication failed. The token may be expired or invalid. Please obtain a fresh token.
error.invalid_token: The auth token is not a valid JWT. Please copy the full x-sec-sa-authtoken value.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.
